title: A bit disappointing, still giving it a try
text:
I have received two boxes so far. They have been hit and miss. My dog refuses to try any of the treats included even if I make them tiny bits. Thought I could use them for super rewards, but he doesn't even want to try them. The toys on the other hand seem appropriate for a puppy under supervision. Tons of squeaky toys and a lot of them are great for playing fetch. The bandanas are nice, but the ones we got were very similar (square patterns). Wish they would include some chewing items in the box and more accessory variety. Also treats that are not too far out there... rather get simple treats that the dog will like... than something that sounds superfancy that the dog might not like.

Item Reviews:
Plushy Coffee Mug 1/5 (super meh) - Dog does not like. Too big for it to carry it, and too boring for pet to like. It isn't pretty to compensate for lack of interest from the dog. Looks like something you would get for free as an advertisement product.
Plushy Chocolate Mug with tiny Marshmellow Plushies (5/5) - Super original and dog loves to play fetch with marshmellows
Plushy Weird Animal - 3/5 - Dog likes it but it is falling apart quick from tiny puppy bites
Bandanas - 3/5 Ok, but need more variety. Dog hates when I put them on since there is no quick clip action.
Treats - 0/5 - I have 4 bags of opened treats that my dog completely ignores.
Poopy Bag Dispenser - 4/5 - I needed one of these. Extra points for including something practical.

Will try for one more month.
label: neutral
